snippet.title: Periapsis: Eclipse - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Periapsis: Eclipse now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320850/Periapsis_Eclipse/

You'll master orbital mechanics and use heat, stealth and gravity to outmaneuver enemies of the Exiled Empire in this realistic and innovative space combat game built by a solo developer. 

Be sure to wishlist on Steam to help support the game's release, subscribe to keep up to date with development and join the community Discord to be a part of the testing and feedback process!
